affected_predicate.description: Two invite links with the requested conditions are created and sent by SMS to Leonard and Ella.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, steps 33–36 repeatedly tap the same top-right control while the owner-profile screen remains unchanged.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the repeated action taps the profile share icon and opens the Android sharing sheet. Each subsequent back action closes that sheet, followed by the same share-icon tap through the final observed step; no invite-link creation or SMS-sending action is observed.

summary: The reused mistaken profile-control action continued an observed share-sheet loop through the final trace, without an observable recovery or completion of either requested invite-link SMS delivery.
